scientific_integrity: All-dimensional analytic primal-dual and equality-case proof; finite rational checker only corroborates. No statement of independent verification or originality certification.
scientific_limitations: A specialized earlier exact cost-sensitive simplex E-optimal-design solution may be indexed under terminology not retrieved; search coverage is not an independence certificate.
The full original 2014 GlobalSIP exact-MSE/sampling paper was not obtained, so its possible historical treatment cannot be ruled out.

The reported exact optimum is defined for one-step worst-initialization squared-error progress divided by expected projection cost; its optimality does not automatically transfer to long-horizon mean-square decay or realized wall-clock efficiency.
title: A quadratic cost frontier for minimax randomized Kaczmarz sampling on simplex frames
